verifications.note: Citrus Corp. 2011 Form 10-K (Southern Union Exhibit 99.2): 'Citrus Corp. maintains 100 percent of the membership interest in Florida Gas Transmission Company, LLC (Florida Gas)' — names the entity by its full legal name and confirms it is held/organized as a single, wholly-integrated 100% membership interest, matching the sheet's Owner1='Florida Gas Transmission Co LLC' / Owner1%='100.00%' with no other named co-owner of the pipeline entity itself.

Southern Union Company 2005 Form 10-K: 'CCE Holdings owns 100 percent of Transwestern and has a 50 percent interest in Citrus Corp, which, in turn, owns 100 percent of Florida Gas' — independently corroborates that Florida Gas Transmission Company is held as one undivided 100% interest at the pipeline-entity level (fragmentation, where it exists, is one level up at Citrus Corp between corporate parents, not at Florida Gas itself).
